jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasksYour work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competenciesYou have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position. 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV). 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and potential PhD diploma). 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications (optional). 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position. 
• References/recommendations. 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.    

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. Interviews are expected to be held during December 2026

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:

Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
• If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. jobs.occupation: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

jobs.occupation: Køkkenchef, India Spice – Fuldtid
jobs.description:
India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

We are best known for our vibrant North and South Indian specialties, aromatic curries, andtandoor dishes, but most importantly, we believe in making authentic food from scratch,using fresh, high-quality ingredients and taking pride in the tradition behind everything we serve.

For us, India Spice is about more than serving great meals. It is about warm hospitality, creating memorable dining experiences, and treating our guests, team members, and partners with respect. We are an ambitious, growing business, but we also want India Spice to be a workplace where people take pride in what they do, enjoy coming to work, and feel a shared responsibility for our quality and standards.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

About the position

As our Kitchen Manager, you will play a central role in keeping the kitchen structured, efficient, and running smoothly across daily prep, restaurant service, and catering orders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

• Maintaining strict hygiene and food safety standards according to Danish Fødevarestyrelsen regulations

• Staff scheduling and daily task delegation for kitchen and prep staff

• Overseeing kitchen maintenance, ensuring equipment, tandoors, and workstations remain clean and in peak condition

• Purchasing, ordering ingredients, spices, packaging, and operational supplies

• Inventory management and stock control to ensure availability for high-volume weekends and large catering orders

• Establishing clear prep routines, portion control, and workflow improvements as our catering demands expand

• Collaborating closely with our chefs and front-of-house team to ensure consistent food quality and punctual service

Qualifications & Qualities:

• Experience working in a professional kitchen, catering operation, or food production environment is an advantage, but having the right mindset is what matters most.

• You are structured, dependable, and punctual, with natural ownership over your responsibilities.

• You are proactive, notice details quickly, and thrive when bringing order and smooth routines to a fast-paced environment.

• You communicate clearly and comfortably in English (Danish is a plus, but not required).

Practical Information

• Position: Kitchen Manager

• Hours: Full-time (37 hours per week)

• Location: Søborg Hovedgade 118, 2860 Søborg

• Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience

• Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV to info@indiaspice.dk with the subject line "Application: Kitchen Manager – India Spice".

If you have any questions regarding the role or India Spice, feel free to contact us at info@indiaspice.dk.

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.
